name: Weaponized

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor contains a slot for a weapon to be integrated into one arm. It takes 10 minutes of work to install or remove a weapon from this slot. The weapon must be of light Bulk or less, can't have weapon upgrades, and must be of a level no higher than the armor. The weapon stored in this slot gains the free-hand trait.
